title: dedicated-autoscaler-priority-routing-burst-controls-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Sofia Kim
release_notes: Enhancement: Autoscaler now supports priority-aware routing to reserved fleets, smoothing token-bucket burst controls, and adds fleet utilization and burst-shed metrics for Dedicated customers.
description: Motivation: Customers running Dedicated fleets reported intermittent SLA dips during sudden traffic spikes where best-effort routing flooded shared pools. This PR adds priority-aware routing, smoother token-bucket burst control, and richer utilization reporting so platform teams can safely guarantee throughput for high-tier customers. Changes: 1) Autoscaler policy: add priority_routing flag and per-priority token_bucket/burst_window settings. 2) Smoothing: implement exponential moving average smoothing for tokenbucket consumption (configurable alpha). 3) Routing: prefer reserved/dedicated pools for priority traffic with automatic fallback. 4) Reporting: new metrics dedicated_fleet_utilization, dedicated_burst_shed_events, per_priority_utilization and adjusted labels for Grafana dashboards. 5) API: FleetAutoscalerConfig schema extended with priority_routing:boolean, burst_window_seconds:int, smoothing_alpha:float. 6) Tests: unit and integration coverage covering edge cases and rollout. Rollout plan: merge to main behind feature flag 'priority_routing_v1', enable for internal staging, run saturation test harness for 48h, then gradual customer rollout by config toggle. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked in Linear ENG-3124 - [x] Schema migration tested - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests added - [x] Observability (metrics + dashboards) updated - [x] Feature-flagged rollout prepared Notes: This PR is focused on production safety; no breaking API changes when flag is off. See files_changed for implementation details and small code snippets in changed files.
